verdict.rationale: Cake does not show AI-generated insights inside the app itself. It does offer an official read-only MCP integration, so an external AI client (Claude, Codex, Cursor) can answer plain-English questions about shareholders, option pool headroom, vesting, share classes, SAFEs and notes from the live cap table. The in-product dashboard's actions list and vesting counts are rule-based, not AI. Missing for 10: native in-product AI insights or suggestions, proactive AI recommendations rather than on-demand Q&A through a third-party client, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
